claims.originating_goal: Preserve bounded non-sensitive diagnostics when the existing HIL browser submission path receives an invalid or non-JSON ingress response, while retaining exact local packet preservation and fail-closed custody semantics.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after PR #987 has clean bounded source validation, merges, and the claim is terminalized with merge evidence.
expected_evidence: bounded HTTP status and normalized Content-Type diagnostics
bounded redirect and final URL scope diagnostics without query or fragment leakage
Check HIL v1 Upload Surface PASS
collision_boundaries: Do not create or configure a new receiver runtime
Do not claim receiver, TVC, publication, admission, or Master Record custody
Do not introduce a second user-operated device dependency
Do not introduce GitHub-token runtime authority or NON-TV/TVC credential authority
Do not consume the HIL lifecycle/runtime ownership of StegVerse-Labs/.github or StegVerse-Labs/TVC
claims.next_task_after_release: Perform one controlled retry of the already-preserved participant packet after deployment and use only the bounded diagnostic result or an authentic receiver receipt as the next runtime evidence.
